summary: Fully tested new Task Category hierarchy feature (rollup stats endpoint + PATCH re-parent with cycle guard + FE Taşı button/inline move form + FE chip progress). Both backend (6/6 pytest) and frontend flows work as specified.
critical_code_review_comments: TasksPanel.jsx is ~2300 lines — consider splitting for maintainability (not a blocker).

Backend TaskCategory.company_id is typed str but existing seed data has null company_id categories; type mismatch is masked by response_model coercion but is a latent risk (creation endpoint now rejects null which is correct).
PATCH re-parent endpoint recomputes descendants by loading up to 5000 rows every move; acceptable for now but O(N) per move — consider indexing / caching if categories scale.
seed_data_creation: test fixture creates TEST_parent_*, TEST_child_*, TEST_sibling_* categories + 3 tasks (2 parent, 1 child, 1 done) under first company; cleaned up in teardown. No residual test data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend: TEST_ prefix cleanup works. If category creation fails with 400 'Şirket seçilmeli' the admin has no company_id and the test needs an explicit company_id fetched from GET /api/companies. UI: overdue-alert modal blocks interactions on login — dismiss with [data-testid=overdue-alert-close] first. Settings tab id is settings-tab-categories. Chips only render for categories that have tasks (empty categories like Kargolama show no chip). Rollup progress bar hidden by design when total=0.
